easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat from step 2.
